title: Detailed heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='heartGlow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b8a'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#e63e62'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b81a3f'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shine' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='45%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3c6' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ff7d9c' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff6b8a' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Main heart shape -->
  <path d='M50 88
           C 20 68, 4 48, 4 32
           C 4 18, 16 10, 28 10
           C 38 10, 46 17, 50 26
           C 54 17, 62 10, 72 10
           C 84 10, 96 18, 96 32
           C 96 48, 80 68, 50 88 Z'
        fill='url(#heartGlow)'/>

  <!-- Left lobe highlight -->
  <path d='M28 16
           C 20 16, 12 22, 12 32
           C 12 44, 24 58, 42 74
           C 36 60, 30 48, 30 38
           C 30 28, 34 20, 38 16 Z'
        fill='#ff8fa8' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Right lobe darker shade -->
  <path d='M72 16
           C 80 16, 88 22, 88 32
           C 88 44, 76 58, 58 74
           C 64 60, 70 48, 70 38
           C 70 28, 66 20, 62 16 Z'
        fill='#c93050' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Top shine -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='26' rx='12' ry='9' fill='url(#shine)'/>

  <!-- Small sparkle -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='24' r='2.5' fill='#ffe0e8' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#fff5f7' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Bottom point highlight -->
  <path d='M48 84 C 46 80, 44 78, 46 74 C 48 76, 50 78, 50 82 Z'
        fill='#ff8fa8' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Inner vein details -->
  <path d='M50 30 C 48 40, 46 50, 48 64'
        stroke='#d43055' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' opacity='0.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 30 C 54 38, 56 48, 54 60'
        stroke='#d43055' stroke-width='1' fill='none' opacity='0.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34 34 C 38 40, 40 46, 40 54'
        stroke='#b81a3f' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none' opacity='0.35' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 34 C 62 40, 60 46, 60 54'
        stroke='#b81a3f' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none' opacity='0.35' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
